terminals.name: ludo-server
terminals.description: Authoritative Ludo game server (shelf HTTP + WebSocket) on port 8080. GET /health returns a JSON status body; any other path is upgraded to the game protocol WebSocket.
terminals.command: export PATH="$PWD/toolchains/dart-sdk/bin:$PWD/toolchains/flutter/bin:$PATH" && cd packages/ludo_server && PORT=8080 LUDO_VERSION=dev dart run bin/server.dart
